settings.announcement: Sunday long-table lunches are back — bookings open for spring

settings.heading: Cooked from what the field gives us today.
settings.subheading: A wood-fired kitchen and sourdough bakery on the edge of town. Our menu changes daily with the harvest from our own farm and twelve neighbouring growers.

settings.heading: What we're serving
settings.intro: Everything is cooked over oak and beech from our own woodland.

blocks.title: Harvest tasting menu
blocks.text: Seven courses built around this week's harvest, with optional natural-wine pairing.

blocks.title: Sunday long table
blocks.text: Family-style roast, shared salads and pies at one long table under the walnut tree.

blocks.title: Bakery counter
blocks.text: Sourdough, cardamom buns and seasonal galettes, baked from 6 am.

blocks.title: Private dining
blocks.text: The old barn for up to 24 guests, with a menu planned around your date.

settings.heading: Rooted in four hectares of clay soil.
settings.text: Hearth & Field grew out of a vegetable garden that got slightly out of hand. Today chef Ines and grower Bram run the kitchen and farm side by side, so what's picked in the morning is on your plate by lunch.

settings.heading: Kind words from the long table

blocks.quote: You can taste that the carrots were in the ground this morning. Honest, generous food.
blocks.author: Lotte J.

blocks.quote: The Sunday lunch felt like eating at a friend's farmhouse. We've booked again already.
blocks.author: Karim & Eva

blocks.quote: Best sourdough in the province. I drive twenty minutes every Saturday.
blocks.author: Wim D.

settings.heading: Find us down the farm lane
Save a seat at the table
settings.text: Tell us your date and party size. For groups over eight, ask about the barn.
